rise of the resistance.ecvDetailNote: ECVs can navigate the queue and preshow areas right up to the interrogation room before transferring to the trackless troop transport.
rise of the resistance.description: Join the Resistance in a massive multi-stage attraction where you are captured by a First Order Star Destroyer and must escape Kylo Ren.

indiana jones adventure.ecvDetailNote: ECVs transfer to a manual wheelchair for the temple queue. The troop transport features intense bumpy motion and requires stepping over a side wall.
indiana jones adventure.description: Board a rugged troop transport through the cursed Temple of the Forbidden Eye alongside Indiana Jones.

space mountain.ecvDetailNote: ECVs transfer to a manual wheelchair; Cast Members can route you to a dedicated offline load rocket for extra boarding time.
space mountain.description: Blast through pitch-black outer space on Disneyland's high-speed indoor roller coaster with a synchronized onboard soundtrack.

tiana's bayou adventure.ecvDetailNote: ECVs transfer to a manual wheelchair for the queue, then step down into the single-file log. Expect a soaking 50-foot plunge.
tiana's bayou adventure.description: Journey through the bayou with Princess Tiana and Louis to find critters for a Mardi Gras celebration before a 50-foot splashdown.

matterhorn bobsleds.ecvDetailNote: ECVs transfer to a manual wheelchair; bobsled seats sit low and narrow, requiring a step down into the sled.
matterhorn bobsleds.description: Hurtle down icy caverns and hairpin turns inside the Matterhorn while dodging the Abominable Snowman.

big thunder mountain.ecvDetailNote: ECVs transfer to a manual wheelchair; exit-side boarding is used for guests needing step-free access to the load platform.
big thunder mountain.description: Careen through a haunted gold-mining town and exploding caverns on the wildest ride in the wilderness.

haunted mansion.ecvDetailNote: ECVs transfer to a manual wheelchair. Cast Members can slow or stop the moving walkway belt for easier boarding into the Doom Buggy.
haunted mansion.description: Glide through a spirited New Orleans estate inhabited by 999 happy haunts aboard a Doom Buggy.

pirates of the caribbean.ecvDetailNote: ECVs transfer to a manual wheelchair at the entrance; guests must step down into the boat. Features two drops in the dark.
pirates of the caribbean.description: Set sail past Blue Bayou and plunge into a classic pirate raid featuring Captain Jack Sparrow and cannon battles.

runaway railway.ecvDetailNote: ECVs can navigate the El CapiTOON Theater queue right up to the boarding area before transferring into the train car.
runaway railway.description: Step inside a Mickey Mouse cartoon short aboard Engineer Goofy's trackless train through unpredictable cartoon worlds.

smugglers run.ecvDetailNote: ECVs transfer to a manual wheelchair; elevator bypasses the stairs to the Millennium Falcon cockpit.
smugglers run.description: Pilot, shoot, or engineer the Millennium Falcon on a high-stakes mission featuring The Mandalorian and Grogu.

peter pan's flight.ecvDetailNote: Exit-side boarding is used for guests with wheelchairs; note the load belt does not stop completely.
peter pan's flight.description: Fly over London and Never Land aboard a magical pirate galleon in Fantasyland's most beloved classic.

alice in wonderland.ecvDetailNote: Exit-side boarding; transfer into the caterpillar ride vehicle.
alice in wonderland.description: Follow the White Rabbit down the rabbit hole and out onto an elevated outdoor vine track aboard a caterpillar.

roger rabbit.ecvDetailNote: ECVs transfer to a manual wheelchair; guests control the spin of Benny the Cab.
roger rabbit.description: Spin through the back alleys of Toontown in Benny the Cab to rescue Jessica Rabbit from the Weasels.

it's a small world.ecvDetailNote: Dedicated accessible boats allow manual wheelchairs to roll directly onboard.
it's a small world.description: Sail past Disneyland's iconic smiling clock facade and through whimsical rooms celebrating children of the world.

jungle cruise.ecvDetailNote: A dedicated accessible boat allows manual wheelchairs to roll directly onboard.
jungle cruise.description: Embark on a pun-filled river expedition led by a witty skipper past animatronic wildlife.

astro blasters.ecvDetailNote: Dedicated accessible Star Cruiser allows manual wheelchairs to roll directly onboard.
astro blasters.description: Spin your Star Cruiser and fire removable laser blasters at targets to help Buzz Lightyear defeat Emperor Zurg.

star tours.ecvDetailNote: ECVs can stay with you up to the boarding door before transferring.
star tours.description: Jump to hyperspace with C-3PO across randomized Star Wars destinations in a 3D motion simulator.

finding nemo submarine.ecvDetailNote: Submarines require climbing down a steep spiral staircase; a ground-level Marine Observation Outpost offers the full HD video experience for wheelchair users.
finding nemo submarine.description: Dive beneath the Tomorrowland lagoon aboard a yellow submarine to search for Nemo.

autopia.minHeight: 32" (81 cm) to Ride, 54" to Drive Alone
autopia.ecvDetailNote: Requires stepping down into the low-slung car.
autopia.description: Cruise along a scenic multi-lane highway winding through Tomorrowland.

mr. toad.ecvDetailNote: Exit-side boarding; transfer into the vintage motorcar.
mr. toad.description: Take a delightfully chaotic drive through London and straight to nowhere in particular in this opening-day Fantasyland classic.

snow white.ecvDetailNote: Exit-side boarding; transfer into the mine cart.
snow white.description: Relive Snow White's fairytale journey with updated lighting, projection effects, and a happily-ever-after finale.

dumbo.ecvDetailNote: Transfer-assist Dumbo vehicle available upon request.
dumbo.description: Soar above Fantasyland aboard your own flying elephant.

storybook land.ecvDetailNote: Requires stepping down into the open-air canal boat.
storybook land.description: Cruise through Monstro the Whale's mouth past handcrafted miniature villages from classic Disney films.

gadgetcoaster.ecvDetailNote: Standard step-over transfer into the acorn coaster car.
gadgetcoaster.description: Zip around a short, quirky Toontown coaster crafted from oversized everyday objects.

winnie the pooh.ecvDetailNote: Dedicated accessible beehive vehicle allows manual wheelchairs to roll directly onboard.
winnie the pooh.description: Bounce through the Hundred Acre Wood aboard a giant beehive.

radiator springs racers.ecvDetailNote: ECVs transfer to a manual wheelchair for the queue; a dedicated transfer car with a wider door opening is available upon request.
radiator springs racers.description: Cruise through Ornament Valley, get a tune-up from Luigi or Ramone, and race side-by-side through red rock canyons at 40 mph.

mission: breakout.ecvDetailNote: ECVs can stay with you through the Collector's Fortress queue right up to the gantry lift doors before transferring.
mission: breakout.description: Help Rocket Raccoon break the Guardians of the Galaxy out of the Collector's Fortress with randomized high-speed drops and classic rock tracks.

incredicoaster.lockerPolicy: Bags Allowed in Pouch (Loose Items Secured)
incredicoaster.ecvDetailNote: Elevator provides access over the track to the load station; standard coaster seat transfer.
incredicoaster.description: Launch from 0 to 55 mph in 4 seconds across Pixar Pier with a single vertical loop as the Parr family chases Jack-Jack.

web slingers.ecvDetailNote: ECVs transfer to a manual wheelchair; a dedicated accessible WEB Slinger vehicle allows manual wheelchairs to roll directly onboard.
web slingers.description: Sling virtual webs with your hands to stop rogue Spider-Bots from overtaking Avengers Campus.

soarin.ecvDetailNote: ECVs can stay with you through the hangar queue right up to the theater doors before transferring into the glider seat.
soarin.description: Lift off into a massive IMAX dome for Soarin' Across America, a breezy hang-gliding flight over iconic U.S. landscapes.

toy story midway mania.ecvDetailNote: ECVs transfer to a manual wheelchair; a dedicated accessible carnival car allows manual wheelchairs to roll straight onboard.
toy story midway mania.description: Compete in fast-paced 3D carnival midway games hosted by Woody, Buzz, and the Toy Story gang.

grizzly river run.ecvDetailNote: A dedicated transfer raft is available; expect to get thoroughly drenched.
grizzly river run.description: Spin down rushing mountain rapids and two geyser drops inside Grizzly Peak.

monsters, inc..ecvDetailNote: A dedicated accessible Monstropolis taxi allows manual wheelchairs to roll directly onboard.
monsters, inc..description: Ride a Monstropolis taxi alongside Sulley and Mike Wazowski to help return Boo safely home.

goofy's sky school.ecvDetailNote: Elevator access to the load platform; sharp hairpin turns.
goofy's sky school.description: Take a comical flying lesson aboard a wild mouse coaster packed with sudden drops and tight turns.

luigi's rollickin'.ecvDetailNote: ECVs transfer to a manual wheelchair; step into the Italian roadster.
luigi's rollickin'.description: Spin and glide in choreographed Italian folk dances aboard trackless Cars Land roadsters.

mater's junkyard.ecvDetailNote: Standard wheelchair transfer into the tractor trailer.
mater's junkyard.description: Whip around spinning turntables pulled by playful tractors while Mater sings country jamboree tunes.

pixar pal-a-round.ecvDetailNote: Manual wheelchairs can roll directly into designated non-swinging gondolas.
pixar pal-a-round.description: Take in sweeping views of Paradise Bay aboard either gentle stationary gondolas or thrilling sliding swinging gondolas.

ariel's undersea.ecvDetailNote: A dedicated clamshell allows manual wheelchairs to roll directly onboard.
ariel's undersea.description: Journey under the sea aboard a clamshell to relive Ariel's musical story from The Little Mermaid.

emotional whirlwind.ecvDetailNote: Accessible memory mover basket available for manual wheelchairs.
emotional whirlwind.description: Lift off inside colorful Inside Out memory movers for a gentle family spin on Pixar Pier.

silly symphony swings.ecvDetailNote: Requires transferring into a suspended swing chair.
silly symphony swings.description: Soar 40 feet above Paradise Bay in tandem or single swings to classical music from The Band Concert.

fantasmic.description: Disneyland's original nighttime spectacular on the Rivers of America featuring Mickey Mouse, pirate ships, water screens, and pyrotechnics.

world of color.description: Dazzling nighttime fountain, laser, fire, and projection spectacular across Paradise Bay at Disney California Adventure.

fireworks.description: Nighttime fireworks and projection spectacular illuminating Sleeping Beauty Castle and Main Street, U.S.A.

a magical life.description: Cinematic tribute to Walt Disney inside the Main Street Opera House culminating in an encounter with a lifelike Walt Disney Audio-Animatronic.

tiki room.description: Walt Disney's original Audio-Animatronic tropical serenade performed by singing birds, flowers, and tiki gods.

philharmagic.description: Indoor 4D musical theater show starring Donald Duck stumbling through classic Disney animated songs.

turtle talk.description: Interactive live Q&A with Crush the sea turtle from Finding Nemo inside the Disney Animation building.

mickey mouse clubhouse live.description: High-energy interactive live stage show featuring Mickey, Minnie, Goofy, Daisy, and Pluto.
